children: BlackLine acquired NetNow, adding AI-enabled customer onboarding and credit risk management to its Invoice-to-Cash platform, linking upstream credit decisions with receivables and cash flow.
Expands platform into credit onboarding, potentially boosting attach rates and AR automation share.
Could improve customer outcomes in cash collections and reduce bad debt risk.
Creates tighter workflow, aiding cross-sell and platform stickiness.

This fits BlackLine’s push to broaden AI-driven finance ops and deepen Invoice-to-Cash coverage. Investor focus now shifts to integration timeline, customer adoption, and any disclosed revenue or margin impact.
